p.i: The commandments of Alma to his son Helaman.

chapter.li: LEChapter36 Verse1 My son, give ear to my words, for I swear unto 2PSF you that inasmuch as 2PSF ye shall keep the commandments of God, 2PSF ye shall prosper in the land. VerseEnd Verse2 I would that 2PSF ye should do as I have done in remembering the captivity of our fathers; for they were in bondage and none could deliver them, except it were the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And he surely did deliver them in their afflictions. VerseEnd Verse3 And now, O my son Helaman, behold, 2PSI thou art in 2PSI thy youth, and therefore I beseech of 2PSI thee that 2PSI thou wilt hear my words and learn of me. For I do know that whosoever shall put their trust in God shall be supported in their trials, and their troubles, and their afflictions, and shall be lifted up at the last day. VerseEnd Verse4 And I would not that 2PSF ye think that I know of myself — not of the temporal, but of the spiritual, not of the carnal mind, but of God. VerseEnd

Verse5 Now behold, I say unto 2PSF you, if I had not been born of God, I should not have known these things. But God has, by the mouth of his holy angel, made these things known unto me — not of any worthiness of myself, VerseEnd Verse6 for I went about with the sons of Mosiah seeking to destroy the church of God; but behold, God sent his holy angel to stop us by the way. VerseEnd Verse7 And behold, he spake unto us as it were the voice of thunder, and the whole earth did tremble beneath our feet, and we all fell to the earth, for the fear of the Lord came upon us. VerseEnd Verse8 But behold, the voice said unto me, Arise. And I arose, and stood up and beheld the angel. VerseEnd Verse9 And he said unto me, If 2PSI thou wilt of thyself, be destroyed; seek no more to destroy the church of God. VerseEnd

Verse10 And it came to pass that I fell to the earth. And it was for the space of three days and three nights that I could not open my mouth, neither had I the use of my limbs. VerseEnd Verse11 And the angel spake more things unto me which were heard by my brethren, but I did not hear them, for when I heard the words — If 2PSI thou wilt, be destroyed of thyself; seek no more to destroy the church of God — I was struck with such great fear and amazement, lest perhaps I should be destroyed, that I fell to the earth and I did hear no more. VerseEnd Verse12 But I was racked with Eternal torment, for my soul was harrowed up to the greatest degree and racked with all my sins. VerseEnd Verse13 Yea, I did remember all my sins and iniquities, for which I was tormented with the pains of hell. Yea, I saw that I had rebelled against my God and that I had not kept his holy commandments. VerseEnd Verse14 Yea, and I had murdered many of his children, or rather led them away unto destruction. Yea, and in fine, so great had been my iniquities that the very thought of coming into the presence of my God did rack my soul with inexpressible horror. VerseEnd Verse15 Oh, thought I, that I could be banished and become extinct, both soul and body, that I might not be brought to stand in the presence of my God to be judged of my deeds. VerseEnd Verse16 And now, for three days and for three nights was I racked, even with the pains of a damned soul. VerseEnd

Verse17 And it came to pass that as I was thus racked with torment, while I was harrowed up by the memory of my many sins, behold, I remembered also to have heard my father prophesy unto the people concerning the coming of one Jesus Christ, a Son of God, to atone for the sins of the world. VerseEnd Verse18 Now as my mind catched hold upon this thought, I cried within my heart, O Jesus, 2PSI thou Son of God, have mercy on me, who art in the gall of bitterness and art encircled about by the everlasting chains of death. VerseEnd Verse19 And now behold, when I thought this, I could remember my pains no more; yea, I was harrowed up by the memory of my sins no more. VerseEnd Verse20 And oh, what joy and what marvelous light I did behold! Yea, my soul was filled with joy as exceeding as was my pains. VerseEnd Verse21 Yea, I say unto 2PSF you, my son, that there can be nothing so exquisite and so bitter as was my pains.

Yea, and again I say unto 2PSF you, my son, that on the other hand, there can be nothing so exquisite and sweet as was my joy. VerseEnd Verse22 Yea, and methought I saw, even as our father Lehi saw, God sitting upon his throne, surrounded with numberless concourses of angels in the attitude of singing and praising their God; yea, and my soul did long to be there. VerseEnd Verse23 But behold, my limbs did receive their strength again, and I stood upon my feet, and did manifest unto the people that I had been born of God. VerseEnd Verse24 Yea, and from that time even until now, I have labored without ceasing, that I might bring souls unto repentance, that I might bring them to taste of the exceeding joy of which I did taste, that they might also be born of God and be filled with the holy ghost. VerseEnd

Verse25 Yea, and now behold, O my son, the Lord doth give me exceeding great joy in the fruits of my labors. VerseEnd Verse26 For because of the word which he has imparted unto me, behold, many have been born of God, and have tasted as I have tasted, and have seen eye to eye as I have seen. Therefore, they do know of these things of which I have spoken as I do know; and the knowledge which I have is of God. VerseEnd Verse27 And I have been supported under trials and troubles of every kind, yea, and in all manner of afflictions. Yea, God has delivered me from prisons, and from bonds, and from death. Yea, and I do put my trust in him, and he will still deliver me. VerseEnd Verse28 And I know that he will raise me up at the last day to dwell with him in glory. Yea, and I will praise him for ever, for he has brought our fathers out of Egypt, and he has swallowed up the Egyptians in the Red Sea, and he led them by his power into the promised land. Yea, and he has delivered them out of bondage and captivity from time to time. VerseEnd Verse29 Yea, and he has also brought our fathers out of the land of Jerusalem. And he has also, by his everlasting power, delivered them out of bondage and captivity from time to time, even down to the present day. And I have always retained in remembrance their captivity; yea, and 2PSF ye also ought to retain in remembrance, as I have done, their captivity. VerseEnd Verse30 But behold, my son, this is not all, for 2PSF ye ought to know as I do know that inasmuch as 2PP ye shall keep the commandments of God, 2PP ye shall prosper in the land. And 2PSF ye ought to know also that inasmuch as 2PP ye will not keep the commandments of God, 2PP ye shall be cut off from his presence. Now this is according to his word. VerseEnd

LEChapter37 Verse1 And now, my son Helaman, I command 2PSF you that 2PSF ye take the records which have been entrusted with me. VerseEnd Verse2 And I also command 2PSF you that 2PSF ye keep a record of this people according as I have done, upon the plates of Nephi, and keep all these things sacred which I have kept, even as I have kept them — for it is for a wise purpose that they are kept — VerseEnd Verse3 and these plates of brass which contain these engravings, which have the records of the holy scriptures upon them, which have the genealogy of our forefathers, even from the beginning. VerseEnd Verse4 And behold, it has been prophesied by our fathers that they should be kept and handed down from one generation to another, and be kept and preserved by the hand of the Lord until they should go forth unto every nation, kindred, tongue, and people, that they shall know of the mysteries contained thereon. VerseEnd Verse5 And now behold, if they are kept, they must retain their brightness, yea, and they will retain their brightness, yea, and also shall all the plates which do contain that which is holy writ. VerseEnd

Verse6 Now 2PSF ye may suppose that this is foolishness in me, but behold, I say unto 2PSF you that by small and simple things are great things brought to pass, and small means in many instances doth confound the wise. VerseEnd Verse7 And the Lord God doth work by means to bring about his great and eternal purposes, and by very small means the Lord doth confound the wise and bringeth about the salvation of many souls. VerseEnd Verse8 And now, it has hitherto been wisdom in God that these things should be preserved. For behold, they have enlarged the memory of this people, yea, and convinced many of the error of their ways and brought them to the knowledge of their God, unto the salvation of their souls. VerseEnd Verse9 Yea, I say unto 2PSF you, were it not for these things that these records do contain, which are on these plates, Ammon and his brethren could not have convinced so many thousands of the Lamanites of the incorrect tradition of their fathers. Yea, these records and their words brought them unto repentance; that is, they brought them to the knowledge of the Lord their God, and to rejoice in Jesus Christ their Redeemer. VerseEnd Verse10 And who knoweth but what they will be the means of bringing many thousands of them, yea, and also many thousands of our stiffnecked brethren the Nephites, who are now hardening their hearts in sins and iniquities, to the knowledge of their Redeemer. VerseEnd Verse11 Now these mysteries are not yet fully made known unto me, therefore I shall forbear. VerseEnd Verse12 And it may suffice if I only say they are preserved for a wise purpose, which purpose is known unto God; for he doth counsel in wisdom over all his works, and his paths are straight, and his course is one eternal round. VerseEnd

Verse13 O remember, remember, my son Helaman, how strict are the commandments of God. And he said, If 2PP ye will keep my commandments, 2PP ye shall prosper in the land, but if 2PP ye keep not his commandments, 2PP ye shall be cut off from his presence. VerseEnd Verse14 And now remember, my son, that God has entrusted 2PSF you with these things which are sacred, which he has kept sacred, and also which he will keep and preserve for a wise purpose in him, that he may show forth his power unto future generations. VerseEnd

Verse15 And now behold, I tell 2PSF you by the spirit of prophecy that if 2PSF ye transgress the commandments of God, behold, these things which are sacred shall be taken away from 2PSF you by the power of God, and 2PSF ye shall be delivered up unto Satan, that he may sift 2PSF you as chaff before the wind. VerseEnd Verse16 But if 2PSF ye keep the commandments of God, and do with these things which are sacred according to that which the Lord doth command 2PSF you — for 2PSF you must appeal unto the Lord for all things whatsoever 2PSF ye must do with them — behold, no power of earth or hell can take them from 2PSF you, for God is powerful to the fulfilling of all his words. VerseEnd Verse17 For he will fulfill all his promises which he shall make unto 2PSF you, for he has fulfilled his promise which he has made unto our fathers. VerseEnd Verse18 For he promised unto them that he would preserve these things for a wise purpose in him, that he might shew forth his power unto future generations. VerseEnd

Verse19 And now behold, one purpose hath he fulfilled, even to the restoration of many thousands of the Lamanites to the knowledge of the truth. And he hath shewn forth his power in them, and he will also still shew forth his power in them unto future generations; therefore, they shall be preserved. VerseEnd Verse20 Therefore, I command 2PSF you, my son Helaman, that 2PSF ye be diligent in fulfilling all my words, and that 2PSF ye be diligent in keeping the commandments of God as they are written. VerseEnd

Verse21 And now I will speak unto 2PSF you concerning those twenty-four plates, that 2PSF ye keep them — that the mysteries, and the works of darkness, and their secret works, or the secret works of those people who have been destroyed, may be made manifest unto this people; yea, all their murders and robbings, and their plunderings, and all their wickedness and abominations may be made manifest unto this people — yea, and that 2PSF ye preserve these directors. VerseEnd Verse22 For behold, the Lord saw that his people began to work in darkness, yea, work secret murders and abominations. Therefore, the Lord said if they did not repent, they should be destroyed from off the face of the earth. VerseEnd Verse23 And the Lord said, I will prepare unto my servant Gazelem a stone which shall shine forth in darkness unto light, that I may discover unto my people who serve me, that I may discover unto them the works of their brethren — yea, their secret works, their works of darkness, and their wickedness and abominations. VerseEnd Verse24 And now, my son, these directors were prepared that the word of God might be fulfilled which he spake, saying, VerseEnd Verse25 I will bring forth out of darkness unto light all their secret works and their abominations, and except they repent, I will destroy them from off the face of the earth. And I will bring to light all their secrets and abominations unto every nation which shall hereafter possess the land. VerseEnd Verse26 And now, my son, we see that they did not repent. Therefore, they have been destroyed, and thus far the word of God has been fulfilled. Yea, their secret abominations have been brought out of darkness and made known unto us. VerseEnd

Verse27 And now, my son, I command 2PSF you that 2PSF ye retain all their oaths, and their covenants, and their agreements in their secret abominations, yea, and all their signs and their wonders 2PSF ye shall retain from this people, that they know them not, lest peradventure they should fall into darkness also and be destroyed. VerseEnd Verse28 For behold, there is a curse upon all this land, that destruction shall come upon all those workers of darkness, according to the power of God, when they are fully ripe; therefore, I desire that this people might not be destroyed. VerseEnd Verse29 Therefore, 2PSF ye shall keep these secret plans of their oaths and their covenants from this people, and only their wickedness, and their murders, and their abominations shall 2PSF ye make known unto them. And 2PSF ye shall teach them to abhor such wickedness, and abominations, and murders, and 2PSF ye shall also teach them that those people were destroyed on account of their wickedness and abominations, and their murders. VerseEnd Verse30 For behold, they murdered all the prophets of the Lord who came among them to declare unto them concerning their iniquities; and the blood of those whom they murdered did cry unto the Lord their God for vengeance upon those who were their murderers; and thus the judgments of God did come upon those workers of darkness and secret combinations. VerseEnd Verse31 Yea, and cursed be the land for ever and ever unto those workers of darkness and secret combinations, even unto destruction, except they repent before they are fully ripe. VerseEnd

Verse32 And now, my son, remember the words which I have spoken unto 2PSF you. Trust not those secret plans unto this people, but teach them an everlasting hatred against sin and iniquity. VerseEnd Verse33 Preach unto them repentance and faith on the Lord Jesus Christ. Teach them to humble themselves and to be meek and lowly in heart. Teach them to withstand every temptation of the Devil with their faith on the Lord Jesus Christ. VerseEnd Verse34 Teach them to never be weary of good works, but to be meek and lowly in heart, for such shall find rest to their souls. VerseEnd Verse35 O remember, my son, and learn wisdom in 2PSI thy youth; yea, learn in 2PSI thy youth to keep the commandments of God. VerseEnd Verse36 Yea, and cry unto God for all 2PG thy support. Yea, let all 2PG thy doings be unto the Lord, and whithersoever 2PG thou goest, let it be in the Lord. Yea, let all 2PG thy thoughts be directed unto the Lord. Yea, let the affections of 2PG thy heart be placed upon the Lord for ever. VerseEnd Verse37 Counsel with the Lord in all 2PG thy doings and he will direct 2PG thee for good. Yea, when 2PG thou liest down at night, lie down unto the Lord, that he may watch over 2PSF you in 2PSF your sleep; and when 2PG thou risest in the morning, let 2PG thy heart be full of thanks unto God. And if 2PSF ye always do these things, 2PSF ye shall be lifted up at the last day. VerseEnd

Verse38 And now, my son, I have somewhat to say concerning the thing which our fathers call a ball or director, or our fathers called it Liahona, which is (being interpreted) a compass; and the Lord prepared it. VerseEnd Verse39 And behold, there cannot any man work after the manner of so curious a workmanship. And behold, it was prepared to shew unto our fathers the course which they should travel in the wilderness; VerseEnd Verse40 and it did work for them according to their faith in God. Therefore, if they had faith to believe that God could cause that those spindles should point the way they should go, behold, it was done. Therefore, they had this miracle, and also many other miracles, wrought by the power of God, day by day. VerseEnd Verse41 Nevertheless, because those miracles were worked by small means, it did shew unto them marvelous works. They were slothful and forgot to exercise their faith and diligence, and then those marvelous works ceased and they did not progress in their journey. VerseEnd Verse42 Therefore, they tarried in the wilderness, or did not travel a direct course, and were afflicted with hunger and thirst because of their transgression. VerseEnd

Verse43 And now, my son, I would that 2PSF ye should understand that these things are not without a shadow. For as our fathers were slothful to give heed to this compass (now these things were temporal), they did not prosper; even so it is with things which are spiritual. VerseEnd Verse44 For behold, it is as easy to give heed to the word of Christ, which will point to 2PSF you a straight course to eternal bliss, as it was for our fathers to give heed to this compass which would point unto them a straight course to the promised land. VerseEnd Verse45 And now I say, is there not a type in this thing? For just as surely as this director did bring our fathers, by following its course, to the promised land, shall the words of Christ, if we follow their course, carry us beyond this vale of sorrow into a far better land of promise. VerseEnd

Verse46 O my son, do not let us be slothful because of the easiness of the way, for so was it with our fathers. For so was it prepared for them, that if they would look, they might live; even so it is with us. The way is prepared, and if we will look, we may live for ever. VerseEnd Verse47 And now, my son, see that 2PSF ye take care of these sacred things, yea, see that 2PSF ye look to God and live. Go unto this people and declare the word, and be sober. My son, farewell. VerseEnd
